scope_note: Two-pass public-evidence review plus directed third- and fourth-pass gap-closure audits for Equinix Seattle SE3 at 2020 Fifth Avenue in Seattle, King County, Washington. The selected account is Equinix's four-level leasehold and current colocation offering inside a landlord-owned former parking-garage property, not the entire parcel, the remaining garage and building systems, nearby SE2 in the Westin Building, or Equinix's wider Seattle portfolio. Direct additions preserve Digital Realty's approximately $4.1 million initial cash contribution for its 50% property joint-venture interest, two non-overlapping original permit values, a current operator-reported colocation-space measure, fourteen annual parcel assessed values, and the exact 2026 real-property bill and partial payments shown by King County. The 2011 lease's 9 MW allocation remains a source projection because no public commissioning or meter record verifies delivered or used load. A low-confidence construction labor-income benchmark now uses reported project hours and a contemporaneous federal metropolitan wage, alongside the retained capacity-to-energy sensitivity and same-account tax-liability break-even identity. Complete project investment, supplier payments, operating employment and payroll, personal-property taxes, exact tenant tax incidence, incentives, public-service costs, utility consumption and expense, emissions, community transfers, and causal county effects remain unresolved.

sources.title: Equinix Opens Second Seattle Data Center
sources.notes: The operator says SE3 opened March 14, 2013 adjacent to SE2, added approximately 51,000 square feet and more than 1,000 cabinet equivalents, and provided 24-hour operations and security. The release supplies no realized investment, site employment, payroll, utility use, property account, incentive, or community amount. Its approximately 51,000-square-foot development description is not treated as the same measure as the current 36,457-square-foot colocation offering.

sources.title: SE3 Seattle IBX Data Center
sources.notes: The current operator page identifies SE3 at 2020 Fifth Avenue and reports 36,457 square feet of colocation space in an eight-story steel-frame concrete structure, N+1 power and cooling redundancy, and more than 30 hours of generator autonomy. It does not disclose generator count or rating, metered electricity, water, expenses, employees, wages, revenue, taxes, or facility investment.

sources.title: Equinix 2011 Form 10-Q, Exhibit 10.2 — 2020 Fifth Avenue Lease
sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Equinix
sources.notes: The executed lease names 2020 Fifth Avenue LLC as landlord and Switch & Data WA One LLC, a wholly owned Equinix subsidiary, as tenant. It covers data-center levels five through eight intended to contain approximately 51,000 square feet for an initial 180-month term, allocates 9 MW from two Seattle City Light basement vaults with actual draw not to exceed 4.5 MW from either vault, and requires the landlord to pay City Light and rebill submetered tenant amounts. It also requires monthly Additional Rent with annual reconciliation, including 100% of real-property taxes and broad general or special assessments minus a parking-garage allocation, and 50% of the annual City skybridge fee. PDF pages 101-102 / printed lease pages 16-17 were rendered and visually inspected for the tax and fee formulas; PDF page 105 / printed lease page 20 was rendered for the electrical allocation. The current tenant tax amount cannot be reconstructed without the landlord's annual reconciliation, current 2020 garage-space count and replacement comparable-garage tax rate. The power allocation was prospective at execution and is not a commissioning record, meter observation, bill, or utility expense.

sources.title: Seattle Services Portal — Construction Permit 6229374-CN

sources.notes: The completed permit records the parking-garage-to-data-center change of use, 47,029 square feet of data-center area on levels five through eight and 43,650 square feet of parking from basement through level four. project_updates.title: Boundary and chronology gap closure
project_updates.project_description: Equinix SE3 is an operating colocation facility at 2020 Fifth Avenue in Seattle, King County, Washington, opened March 14, 2013 after conversion and vertical expansion of a 1975 parking garage. This account follows Equinix's four-level leasehold and current 36,457-square-foot colocation offering within parcel 0659000905; it does not treat the landlord's wider building and garage or nearby Equinix SE2 in the Westin Building as the same facility. Seattle permits document data-center floors five through eight and completion in March 2013, while the 2011 lease allocated up to 9 MW from two Seattle City Light vaults.
project_updates.notes: Gap closure cross-checked the IM3-selected address against Equinix's current SE3 address, the executed lease, Seattle permits 6229374-CN/6262351-CN/3010224-LU, assessor parcel 0659000905, the current skybridge/permit trail and the March 14, 2013 opening release. The lease separately defines Westin Building conduit/skybridge rights, while Equinix currently lists SE2 at 2001 Sixth Avenue and SE3 at 2020 Fifth Avenue.
